cards.text: Jesus has been raised from the dead, and later, by the Sea of Tiberias, He shows Himself to His disciples again. Seven of them are together: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, two other disciples, and the sons of Zebedee, James and John (Matthew 4:21).

cards.question: The disciples are together by the sea. Simon Peter tells the others what he's going to do. What is it?

cards.text: The others say, “We will go with you,” and they get into the boat. That night they catch nothing, and friend, I've stared at dough that wouldn't rise till sunrise, so I FEEL that boat.

cards.question: Early in the morning, Jesus is standing on the shore, but the disciples don't recognize that it's Him. He calls out to them in the boat. What does He ask?

answers.text: If He can use their boat

cards.text: “No,” they answer. So He tells them to cast the net on the right side of the boat, and He says they'll find some.

cards.question: The disciples cast the net on the right side of the boat, just like the Man on the shore says, and it comes up empty again.
The net is so full of fish the disciples can't haul it in. Then the disciple whom Jesus loved tells Peter, “It is the Lord!” What does Peter do as soon as he hears it?

answers.text: He kneels down in the boat
He shouts back to the shore

cards.text: Before Peter jumps, he puts his outer garment on, since he'd taken it off. The man got DRESSED to go swimming, and friend, I respect it.

cards.question: Peter's in the water. The other disciples come ashore in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, since they're not far from land. How far out are they?

cards.text: When they land, there's a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread. That's like dragging yourself into the bakery before sunrise and the oven's already warm, a batch already cooling, and you didn't do a THING.
Jesus tells them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.” So Simon Peter goes aboard and drags the net ashore, full of large fish, 153 of them.

cards.question: Peter drags the net ashore with 153 large fish in it, but even with so many, the net is not ___.

cards.text: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus says to them. Not one of the disciples dares to ask Him who He is.

cards.question: At breakfast by the fire, the disciples know it's the Lord.
At breakfast by the fire, ___ takes the bread and gives it to the disciples, and does the same with the fish.

cards.text: This is now the third time Jesus has appeared to the disciples since He was raised from the dead. And friend, I'm sliding this one back in the oven, because this story's not done yet.
